title: Not an MCP-protocol server — implemented as a Flask REST API
evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp/server.py:42 `from flask import Flask, jsonify, request`; endpoints are HTTP routes (@app.route '/query','/team/<name>','/player/<name>','/standings' at server.py:129,252,265,281). grep -rniE 'from mcp|import mcp|fastmcp|@mcp\.|list_tools|call_tool|stdio_server|Tool\(' across brazilian_soccer_mcp/ and tests/ returns no MCP SDK usage (only the package name brazilian_soccer_mcp). README.md:50 lists `pip install ... mcp` but no module ever imports it. REQUIREMENTS R1 requires an MCP server entrypoint + registered tools/resources (server SDK usage, tool definitions).
suggestion: Replace/​wrap the Flask app with an MCP server (e.g. `from mcp.server import Server` / FastMCP), register each query handler as an MCP tool via @mcp.tool / list_tools+call_tool, and expose over stdio.
